Pilsner Lager was first brewed in the 1930s in Allsopps brewery, growing to become of the leading
beer brands for EABL in Kenya, Uganda, and Tanzania.
Pilsner boasts superior liquid clarity through cold filtering for a crisp refreshing taste that is inspired
by the original Pilsner brewing process in Europe.
Pilsner celebrates the success of Uganda’s urban youth culture. It’s a toast to their resilience and
grit and an invitation to savour every moment on the journey to success. In FY2023/24, Pilsner
cemented its place as the leading partner of Ugandan culture, through partnership with Buganda
and Toro Ankole kingdoms.
We continued to delight consumers by activating 14 cultural partnerships, leveraging the culture
platform to connect with the consumers in the lively upbeat occasion.
